title: Mobile menu of rmarkdown site is incompatible with the Highcharter library
description:
If you install the dev verison of flexdashboard, you can use Bootstrap 4, which seems to solve the issue:

````
---
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    theme:
      version: 4
---
````

You can also read more about the new `theme` capabilities here https://flexdashboard-pkg.netlify.app/articles/theme.html

_Originally posted by @cpsievert in https://github.com/rstudio/flexdashboard/issues/328#issuecomment-822512704_
